reviewCharts.warning: Georgia native review rows use official Georgia Secretary of State media-export precinct presidential rows paired with U.S. House rows from the same SOS media export where comparable. U.S. House is district-based and candidate-specific, so directional screens are low-confidence advisory context rather than candidate-benefit findings. Eight nonzero precinct rows have one-sided House comparison coverage, 39 precinct keys aggregate more than one House district and are excluded from down-ballot dropoff calculations, county presidential candidate rows sum 19 votes higher than the statewide presidential contest total in minor-party/other rows, and 17 zero-total precinct entries are omitted from review charts.

turnout.notes: Georgia turnout rows use EAC 2024 V2 county/jurisdiction fallback rows. A July 5, 2026 review of the official Georgia SOS media export confirmed vote-method candidate splits for President but no registered-voter denominator or election-level ballots-cast field; President candidate votes are 47,453 below EAC ballots cast, so the export is not a turnout replacement.

historicalBaselines.warning: Georgia historical baseline rows are official county-level presidential results from Georgia Secretary of State media exports for 2012, 2016, and 2020. Use them as contextual baseline rows, not as 2024 certified data. The 2020 media export reports the original November general-election export total; separate recount result tables should be reconciled before replacing or combining those rows.

historicalReview.warning: Georgia historical advisory rows compare official county presidential results with official U.S. Senate results from the same county. The 2016 comparison is United States Senator, Isakson. The 2020 comparison is the regular US Senate (Perdue) contest from the original November general export, before the runoff; the Loeffler special election is excluded. Candidate and contest differences, split-ticket voting, and participation differences can explain observed patterns. The selected source options contain no precinct results, so this is county-only advisory context, not a finding of misconduct.
